args.title: Historical note: Alex’s informal May 2023 service responsibilities
args.body:
On May 2, 2023, Alex’s runbook-audit inventory identified two older services he informally treated as responsibilities alongside his three directly owned services (metrics-router, ingest-edge, and shard-keeper):

- legacy-aggregator: Alex informally owned it because nobody had fully completed the migration away from it.
- metric-rollup: Alex informally owned the old metric-rollup service, which was effectively unowned in practice.

These were informal responsibilities, distinct from the explicitly assigned ownership map established later in the audit.
